etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: Variant of 終日(ひめもす) (himemosu).

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: Variant of 終日(ひねもす) (hinemosu).

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: そこば (sokoba, see 若干) + く (ku, ancient suffix used to form adverbs; compare か (ka) used to form adjectives)

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: そこ (soko) + ば (ba, “much, amount”, ancient element, also appears in 幾許 (kokoba) and 幾許 (ikubaku))
